definitions.gloss: clear soup; clear broth; Japanese consommé
definitions.explanation: A light, clear Japanese soup made with dashi broth, seasoned with soy sauce and salt. Distinguished from miso soup by its transparency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汁物|しるもの}→汁物：06231_shirumono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{澄|す}まし{汁|じる}にした。
examples.english: I made clear soup for today's soup dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{澄|す}まし{汁|じる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑煮|ぞうに}→雑煮：14581_zouni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are regions where ozoni (New Year soup) is made with clear broth.

examples.japanese: {澄|す}まし{汁|じる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{三|み}つ{葉|ば}→三つ葉：11242_mitsuba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧、⟦さっぱりした→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: I added tofu and mitsuba to the clear soup to give it a light, refreshing flavor.

notes:
Also called ⟦お{吸|す}い{物|もの}→お吸い物：15773_osuimono⟧. Made from ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ (dashi stock) seasoned with ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce) and ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt), with simple garnishes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {澄|す}まし{汁|じる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make clear soup
- {澄|す}まし{汁|じる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑煮|ぞうに}→雑煮：14581_zouni⟧: New Year soup with clear broth
- {澄|す}まし{汁|じる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧: clear soup ingredients/garnishes

COMMON INGREDIENTS:
- ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧: tofu
- ⟦{三|み}つ{葉|ば}→三つ葉：11242_mitsuba⟧: mitsuba (Japanese parsley)
- ⟦{麩|ふ}→麩：24202_fu⟧: wheat gluten
- ⟦{柚子|ゆず}→柚子：13102_yuzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: yuzu peel (as a garnish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{吸|す}い{物|もの}→お吸い物：15773_osuimono⟧: clear soup — essentially the same dish; this name is more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: miso soup — the other main type of Japanese soup; uses miso paste instead of clear seasoning
